task_completion.description: Open the DICOM Send or DICOM Nodes configuration window in Weasis.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A preferences or settings dialog box is visible, specifically showing DICOM node management or 'DICOM Send' options.

task_completion.description: Enter the correct configuration details for the new DICOM destination.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The input fields in the DICOM node configuration show: Description/Name: 'Local PACS', AE Title: 'LOCAL_PACS', Hostname: '127.0.0.1', and Port: '4242'.

task_completion.description: Save or add the newly configured DICOM node to the list of destinations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Local PACS' node appears in the list of configured DICOM destinations within the Weasis interface.

task_completion.description: Select the loaded study and initiate the 'Send to DICOM' command.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A right-click menu or toolbar action for 'Send to DICOM' or 'Export to DICOM node' is selected while a study is active.

task_completion.description: Select 'Local PACS' as the target and confirm the transfer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box shows 'Local PACS' selected as the destination node before the user clicks 'Send' or 'OK'.

task_completion.description: Confirm the DICOM series was successfully sent via a progress bar or success notification.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar completes, or a notification/log entry within Weasis indicates 'Transfer successful' or 'Sent 100%'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to configure the node and send the data, rather than command-line tools like 'dcmsend'.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements and interactions with the Weasis application windows, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move files to the destination directory using the file manager.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the DICOM protocol settings in Weasis, not dragging and dropping files in a file explorer.

integrity.description: The agent actually typed or pasted the specific values into the Weasis UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The configuration fields (AE Title, Port, etc.) are visibly populated within the Weasis settings dialog.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The destination must be configured with AE Title: LOCAL_PACS, Hostname: 127.0.0.1, and Port: 4242. A local receiver (storescp) is listening on these parameters and saves files to /tmp/pacs_received. Success is defined by the Weasis UI confirming the transfer to this specific node.
